Zhejiang Sibeile Cooling Electric Co., L.event: Renamed to Spelor Electrical Appliances (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd.
Zhejiang Sibeile Cooling Electric Co., L.evidence: Patent records from Google Patents indicate that Zhejiang Sibeile Refrigeration Electric Co., Ltd. officially changed its name to Spelor Electrical Appliances (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd. in 2020. Consequently, it no longer operates under the original Sibeile name, though its successor entity remains active in the commercial ice cream machine market.
